out.subject: Committed annual volume – revised contract package
out.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your offer. You said that you prioritise customers with firm, long-term commitments. We have structured our proposal on that basis.

The proposed package is a binding annual volume of 23400 pcs throughout a 24-month contract, with a delivery lead time of 56 days and a proposed unit price of EUR 27.47. The annual quantity is a contractual commitment, not merely a forecast.

I have attached our latest shared forecast as the planning basis; see the figures below. This provides the demand profile alongside the firm annual commitment in the proposed package.

I am also open to discussing a longer contract term if that helps your production planning. What price can you offer for this committed volume?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing
out.rationale: Offer a firm annual commitment with a longer contract term and the shared forecast as planning support. Use an open price question to invite a revised package rather than requesting immediate confirmation.
